newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sydney Casino tops turnover lists.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sydney Casino tops turnover lists.

text.p: Shares in Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd topped turnover lists in early trade on Thursday with 26.51 million shares or about 6.8 percent of its capital traded.
The bulk of the trade was in two lines of 13.42 million each specialled through Merrill Lynch, with one line done at A$2.255 per share while the second line was done at A$2.26 per share.
A Sydney Harbour Casino spokesman told Reuters the company was unaware at this stage of the identities of the parties to the transaction.
"No-one has advised us as yet. It is not someone who is currently a substantial shareholder but we may hear more later in the day," the spokesman said.
By 10.45 a.m. (2345 GMT), Sydney Harbour Casino shares were five cents lower at A$2.30.
